decision: FINAL.54 owner privacy-safe highway report already received. Local Chubu OSM catalog successfully retrieved 244 IC candidate nodes with zero remote requests, 2 entry/exit pairs evaluated and 2 HGV via route candidates with meaningful motorway; final eligible zero and selected motorway 0.0km.

Current `api/route.mjs` candidate filter requires priorityMeters>100 (guaranteed for accepted nonzero motorway candidates), extra duration <= min(8min,20% baseline) AND extra distance <= min(10km,30% baseline). Both accepted via routes failed one or both extra time/distance limits. Current report does NOT reveal the relative duration/distance, hence no assertion which one is exceeded.

Do NOT relax the current time/distance selection caps, force toll highways or increase ORS calls without evidence/owner's explicit product choice; candidate legal usability remains subject to registered 2t driving-hgv.
Proposed narrow FINAL.55 instrumentation: privacy-safe time/distance rejection counters and rounded excess per via candidate, in separate Issue #235. Not yet implemented or authorized.
Keep FINAL.54 in production; AN15 paused, OSM source/ODbL and 120-day freshness, ORS 30/min and max two optional IC probes, ferry and HGV constraints untouched.
nextActions: HUMAN PRODUCT CHOICE: approve or direct Issue #235 narrow FINAL.55 diagnosis instrumentation showing whether 2 via HGV candidates violated time, distance or both and approximate excess; maintain existing selection caps.
Only after new instrument is released, retest same DCM尾西店→飛島コンテナ surroundings with highway ON and collect NEW versioned privacy-safe diagnosis (not the already-received FINAL.54).
Do not change HGV restrictions, usage limits, ferry avoidance, original +8min/+10km bounded detour policy, or AN15 pause without separate user decision.
